comparison.objective: Orient and insert a DIP chip into a ZIF socket, then close its lever.
comparison.physical_skill: In-air reorientation, pin-slot insertion, and ordered latching; no tuning from dynamic feedback.
comparison.success_condition: Notch faces lever, pins enter slots, lever closes afterward. Numeric insertion tolerances and spec versions are absent.
comparison.reason: Although both include a retained mechanism and fine manipulation, chip insertion tests a different ability.
